title: Flix Reference-Compiler Defect Ledger Schema
description: Schema for defects/ledger.json: defects observed in the reference compiler that this suite inherits and cannot falsify. Bounded on purpose -- every entry carries an owner, a disposition, a runnable reproducer with a declarative assertion, and a review date, so the ledger cannot become a parking lot for untriaged observations.

note.description: Maintenance note explaining the file's contract to a human editor.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never reused, never renumbered -- consumers cite these.

component.description: The reference component the defect lives in.

disposition.description: What is being done about it. There is no 'unclassified': an entry without a decision is not ready to be in the ledger.

impact.description: What it means for a consumer -- specifically, what conformance now requires that it arguably should not.

firstObservedAtPin.description: Informational: the upstream commit the defect was first observed at. Not a gate -- the assertion below is re-run at whatever pin is current, which is a stronger check than comparing commits.

reproducer.description: Minimized source that exhibits the defect.

upstreamStatus.description: Whether this has been reported upstream. Explicit so that 'nobody told them' is a recorded state rather than an omission.

upstreamIssue.description: URL of the upstream issue. Must be a URL when upstreamStatus is 'filed', and null when it is not.

owner.description: Who re-triages this at the review date.

review.description: Date by which the entry must be re-triaged. Past this date the build fails.

Assertion.description: Declarative statement of how the defect shows in a projected tree, re-checked against the pinned oracle on every run. This is what makes an entry falsifiable: when upstream fixes the defect the assertion stops holding and the build says so.

parsesCleanly.description: Whether the reproducer is expected to parse without diagnostics.

absentKinds.description: Kinds that must NOT appear -- typically the kind the reference intends but cannot emit.

presentKinds.description: Kinds that must appear, pinning what is emitted instead.
